name: linkedin-personal-branding
description: Review a LinkedIn profile with the user's own logged-in browser and build an evidence-backed personal branding blueprint: authority scores, findings, a full profile rewrite, three lead magnets, and a 60-day content plan.

interface.shortDescription: Turn your LinkedIn profile into an authority blueprint with a 60-day content plan.
interface.longDescription: Collects your LinkedIn profile, recent posts, and comments through your own logged-in browser (no third-party scraping APIs), computes deterministic activity metrics, scores your profile against a five-dimension authority rubric, then generates a complete personal branding kit: findings, strategy, a full profile rewrite with three headline variants, three lead magnet concepts, and a 60-day content plan with ready-to-paste posts.
defaultPrompt: Review my LinkedIn profile and build my personal branding blueprint.
Run a LinkedIn personal branding review for this profile URL.
Build my 60-day LinkedIn content plan from my profile and recent posts.
